# Gyres spec

> The client contract of Gyres Core: HTTP endpoints, Server-Sent Events and guides for building a Gyres frontend. Latest release only. Every endpoint section starts with `### METHOD /path`, then `Auth:` (none / any key / admin), `Effect:`, Request, Response, Errors, Events.

All files in one: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Start

- [README](README.md): basics, auth, compatibility with `GET /v1/version`
- [Errors](errors.md): error body, coded errors, auth failures
- [Events](events.md): every SSE event (Core-wide and per-run)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): breaking changes per `api_version`

## Guides

- [Pairing and access keys: get a key, check role and api_version](guides/pairing-and-keys.md)
- [List conversations and keep the list fresh](guides/list-conversations.md)

- [Stop a run and reattach to it](guides/stop-and-reattach.md)
- [Tool approvals and user questions](guides/approvals.md)
